node.title: Distributed Tiger Teams VS Freelancer Swarms
node.reading:
Distributed work is not defined by distance. The decisive distinction is whether accountability, context and operational truth remain integrated across the team.

The Distributed American Innovation account provides an operating setting for work across regions. Define the shared mission, the recipient’s constraints and the route for resolving an exception. Moving a task without its evidence and decision conditions merely relocates coordination work.

Long before 2020, distributed teams already existed in several forms. Some worked on template-based tasks at scale. Some operated as independent high-capability freelancers delivering specialised outputs. Others became fully distributed companies, where entire functions such as teaching, marketing, administration, library management, student coordination or field support operated remotely across locations.

It was not a marketplace of interchangeable freelancers. It was not a collection of isolated experts delivering separate pieces of work. It was not simply a company allowing remote work.

It was a high-trust, high-context, high-responsibility operating model designed for frontier operations integration.
node.readingSummary: Distributed work is not defined by distance.

relations: Shared mission accountability does not erase the distinct authority conditions that must accompany a handoff between operational owners.
La comparación no convierte una red de especialistas en una implementación del protocolo de handoff EA.
A shared operational record should preserve evidence status and receiving-decision authority instead of turning agreement into a claim of established fact.
La disciplina histórica no se declara implementación del contrato EA. La integración propuesta requiere semántica y reglas reales de promoción.
A common decision core may reduce human-as-API work, provided the cost of maintaining and qualifying that core is included in the comparison.
No se ha medido aquí ese efecto y un repositorio central puede crear nuevas reconciliaciones.
For a complementary reading, see [Authority and accountability in the Tiger Team model](https://jubap.net/tiger-team-governance-principles/).
